Cleaning during your stay is AED 265/visit and includes linen change (bedsheets, pillowcases, towels), vacuuming, mopping, and trash disposal. The unit is cleaned before check-in, so this would only apply if you want a session mid-stay.

Take the time you need, just so you know, the calendar is live across platforms so availability can move. Ready to hold September 11 once you've had the chance to discuss?
